justification: The engine ships refusing. Running a model over untrusted captured text with the filesystem open is a risk only the operator of a particular instance can accept, on their own machine and against their own data, so the published engine records no acceptance and no evidence of anyone else's. An operator who wants a model synthesizer writes their own decision and its probe rows in their data directory and names it in clips.boundaryDecision; docs/boundary-decision.md states what they are accepting. Until then --manual is the synthesizer, which needs no model, no credits and no boundary at all.
